messageBody:
## Community Coordinated Modeling Center Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information ( CCMC DONKI )
## Message Type: Space Weather Notification - CMEs (Parker Solar Probe, Mars, OSIRIS-APEX)
##
## Message Issue Date: 2024-05-23T18:27:07Z
## Message ID: 20240523-AL-002
##
## Disclaimer: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center is the United States Government official source for space weather forecasts. This "Experimental Research Information" consists of preliminary NASA research products and should be interpreted and used accordingly.


## Summary:

Multiple CMEs have been detected as follows:
1: C-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-05-23T04:24Z.

Estimated speed: ~507 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 35 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 62/-26 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-23T04:24:00-CME-001

2: C-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-05-23T13:25Z.

Estimated speed: ~512 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 41 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 66/-24 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-23T13:25:00-CME-001

3: S-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-05-23T10:12Z.

Estimated speed: ~337 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 37 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 65/-31 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-05-23T10:12:00-CME-001

Based on preliminary analysis by the Moon to Mars Space Weather Analysis Office and heliospheric modeling carried out at NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center, it is estimated that the CMEs may impact Parker Solar Probe, Mars (glancing blow), and OSIRIS-APEX (glancing blow).  The leading edge of the CMEs will reach Parker Solar Probe at 2024-05-25T19:02Z and the flank of it will reach Mars at 2024-05-28T11:30Z, and OSIRIS-APEX at 2024-05-27T03:00Z (plus minus 7 hours).

## Notes: 

The CME event with ID 2024-05-23T04:24:00-CME-001 is likely associated with M1.7 flare from Active Region 3679 (S10W62) with ID 2024-05-23T04:03:00-FLR-001 which peaked at 2024-05-23T04:29Z.

The CME event 2024-05-23T10:12:00-CME-001 is associated with M1.0 flare from Active Region 3679 (S09W65) with ID 2024-05-23T10:03:00-FLR-001 which peaked at 2024-05-23T10:08Z.

The CME event 2024-05-23T13:25:00-CME-001 is associated with M2.5 flare from Active Region 3679 (S10W66) with ID 2024-05-23T12:48:00-FLR-001 which peaked at 2024-05-23T13:20Z.


SCORE CME typification system:
S-type: CMEs with speeds less than 500 km/s
C-type: Common 500-999 km/s
O-type: Occasional 1000-1999 km/s
R-type: Rare 2000-2999 km/s
ER-type: Extremely Rare >3000 km/s
